name: Karis-Inspired Anti-Flicker
definition: Heuristic anti-flicker method that biases the signal towards the frame where clipping occurs, reducing the impact of quick impulses. Uses linear scaling of blend factor based on distance to clipping.
summary: Karis-Inspired Anti-Flicker is a heuristic temporal anti-aliasing technique that reduces visual flicker in froxel-based volumetric rendering by dynamically adjusting blend factors based on clipping discontinuities.
